create_dpt_image_processor: create a DPTImageProcessor instance for resizing and preprocessing images for depth estimation models
resize_dpt_image_processor: resize a torch.Tensor image to a target size with aspect ratio preservation and size divisor constraints
pad_dpt_image_processor: center pad a torch.Tensor image so its dimensions are multiples of a given size divisor
preprocess_dpt_image_processor: preprocess a list of torch.Tensor images with resize, crop, rescale, normalize, and pad operations
post_process_depth_estimation_dpt_image_: post-process DepthEstimatorOutput raw predictions into final depth tensors resized to target sizes
